title: JMS581DL manufacturer design-in packet
manufacturer_facts: JMS581DL is a 144TFBGA 9x9 mm USB 3.2 Gen2 to SATA 6 Gb/s and PCIe Gen3 x2 bridge with 3.3-V I/O.
The packet contains a four-sheet demo schematic, PowerPCB reference PCB/ASCII, layout guide, BOM and SPI support list.
Reference mode records select SATA or PCIe behavior through GPIO18/PEDET and include USB-C/M-key storage hardware.
Layout guidance specifies continuous reference planes and 90-ohm USB3, 100-ohm PCIe slot/SATA, and 85-ohm M.2 guidance; exact dimensions belong to the reference stackup.
Reference power guidance calls for local bypass and wider high-current VCCK/AVDDL distribution; datasheet supplies device rail ranges and typical currents.
SPI list identifies supported external flash families but does not establish PiSXMe production firmware rights or provisioning.
